name: save_flows
description: keyword to indicate that all model package flow terms will be written to the file specified with 'BUDGET FILEOUT' in Output Control.

name: print_input
description: keyword to indicate that the list of all model stress package information will be written to the listing file immediately after it is read.

name: print_flows
description: keyword to indicate that the list of all model package flow rates will be printed to the listing file for every stress period time step in which 'BUDGET PRINT' is specified in Output Control.

name: obs_filerecord
description: is the file name of the observations input file for this exchange.
notes: Observations only produce output. [observations] in dev3 already declares the binding parameter on the target.

name: auxiliary
description: defines an array of one or more auxiliary variable names.

name: boundnames
description: keyword to indicate that boundary names may be provided with the list of constant-head cells.
notes: Non-unique group label; OBS can select by it.

name: ts_filerecord
description: defines a time-series file defining time series that can be used to assign time-varying values.
notes: Not layout: TS/TAS interpolate within a period, which period data cannot express without changing TDIS.
derivation_basis: values interpolated from series each time step

name: export_array_ascii
description: keyword that specifies input griddata arrays should be written to layered ascii output files.

name: auxmultname
description: name of auxiliary variable to be used as multiplier of CHD head value.
notes: Was the closest call (layout). Relabelled by the derivation axis: bound = value × aux is evaluated at every use against the current aux value, which may be a TS, so the rule itself is model content (dynamic derivation). Same structure as AUXDEPTHNAME. Snapshot re-encoding (multiply in) is still possible but loses the rule.
derivation_basis: value × aux at every use (wel:766, rch:271, chd:427); aux may be a TS

name: export_array_netcdf
description: keyword that specifies input gridded arrays should be written to the model output NetCDF file with attributes that support using the generated file as a MODFLOW 6 simulation input.

name: budget_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write budget information.

name: budgetcsv_filerecord
description: name of the comma-separated value (CSV) output file to write budget summary information.

name: angrot
description: counter-clockwise rotation angle (in degrees) of the model grid coordinate system relative to a real-world coordinate system.
notes: Descriptive metadata: no runtime effect, kept by any conversion.

name: crs
description: is a real-world coordinate reference system (CRS) for the model, for example, an EPSG integer code (e.g.
notes: Descriptive metadata: no runtime effect, kept by any conversion.

name: grb_filerecord
description: defines a binary grid output file.

name: length_units
description: is the length units used for this model.
notes: Descriptive metadata: no runtime effect, kept by any conversion.

name: nogrb
description: keyword to deactivate writing of the binary grid file.

name: xorigin
description: x-position of the origin used for model grid vertices.
notes: Descriptive metadata: no runtime effect, kept by any conversion.

name: yorigin
description: y-position of the origin used for model grid vertices.
notes: Descriptive metadata: no runtime effect, kept by any conversion.

name: mover
description: keyword to indicate that this instance of the api boundary Package can be used with the Water Mover (MVR) Package.
notes: Target-side declaration that the package takes part in an MVR relation.

name: flow_package_auxiliary_name
components: gwe-lke gwe-mwe gwe-sfe gwe-uze gwt-lkt gwt-mwt gwt-sft gwt-uzt
description: keyword to specify the name of an auxiliary variable in the corresponding flow package.
notes: References a column of another package's table.

name: flow_package_name
components: gwe-lke gwe-mwe gwe-sfe gwe-uze gwt-lkt gwt-mwt gwt-sft gwt-uzt
description: keyword to specify the name of the corresponding flow package.

name: ncf_filerecord
components: gwe-dis gwe-disv gwf-dis gwf-disv gwt-dis gwt-disv prt-dis prt-disv
description: defines a NetCDF configuration (NCF) input file.
notes: NCF is mostly NetCDF output config (chunking, deflate); its WKT is logical metadata and duplicates DIS CRS.

name: list
components: chf-nam gwe-nam gwf-nam gwt-nam olf-nam prt-nam swf-nam
description: is name of the listing file to create for this CHF model.

name: concentration_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write concentration information.

name: length_conversion
description: real value that is used to convert user-specified Manning's roughness coefficients from meters to model length units.
notes: Constant factor in Manning's eq. (unitconv=L^(1/3)*T). Re-encode n'=n/unitconv. Lens spans DFW+CXS.
derivation_basis: constant factor

name: readarraygrid
description: indicates that array-based grid input will be used for the constant head package.
notes: Grid-array encoding of a stress list (CHDG etc.). Partial lens like READASARRAYS.

name: stage_filerecord
description: name of the output file to write stage information.

name: temperature_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write temperature information.

name: time_conversion
description: real value that is used to convert user-specified Manning's roughness coefficients from seconds to model time units.
notes: Constant factor in Manning's eq. (unitconv=L^(1/3)*T). Re-encode n'=n/unitconv. Lens spans DFW+CXS.
derivation_basis: constant factor

name: fixed_cell
description: indicates that evapotranspiration will not be reassigned to a cell underlying the cell specified in the list if the specified cell is inactive.

name: newtonoptions
description: none

name: package_convergence_filerecord
description: name of the comma spaced values output file to write package convergence information.

name: print_concentration
description: keyword to indicate that the list of lake {#2} will be printed to the listing file for every stress period in which 'CONCENTRATION PRINT' is specified in Output Control.

name: print_temperature
description: keyword to indicate that the list of lake {#2} will be printed to the listing file for every stress period in which 'TEMPERATURE PRINT' is specified in Output Control.

name: central_in_space
description: keyword to indicate conductance should be calculated using central-in-space weighting instead of the default upstream weighting approach.

name: dev_interfacemodel_on
description: activates the interface model mechanism for calculating the coefficients at (and possibly near) the exchange.

name: dev_no_newton
description: turn off Newton for unconfined cells

name: dev_swr_conductance
description: use the conductance formulation in the Surface Water Routing (SWR) Process for MODFLOW-2005.

name: nc_filerecord
description: NetCDF filerecord
notes: Names the NetCDF file that NETCDF-tagged arrays are read from. Where data lives, not what it is.

name: nc_mesh2d_filerecord
description: NetCDF layered mesh fileout record.

name: nc_structured_filerecord
description: NetCDF structured fileout record.

name: qoutflow_filerecord
description: name of the output file to write conc information.

name: readasarrays
description: indicates that array-based input will be used for the Evapotranspiration Package.
notes: Runtime memory of RCH/RCHA converges. Partial lens: list→array fails for >1 entry per column; array form has no boundnames.

name: save_velocity
description: keyword to indicate that x, y, and z components of velocity will be calculated at cell centers and written to the budget file, which is specified with 'BUDGET SAVE FILE' in Output Control.

name: tas_filerecord
description: defines a time-array-series file defining a time-array series that can be used to assign time-varying values.
notes: Not layout: TS/TAS interpolate within a period, which period data cannot express without changing TDIS.
derivation_basis: arrays interpolated from series each time step

name: vertical_offset_tolerance
description: checks are performed to ensure that the top of a cell is not higher than the bottom of an overlying cell.
notes: Run directive: input validation. Changes whether the run errors, not what it computes.

name: adv_scheme
description: scheme used to solve the advection term.

name: afrcsv_filerecord
description: name of the comma-separated value (CSV) output file to write information about well extraction rates that have been reduced by the program.

name: ats_outer_maximum_fraction
description: real value defining the fraction of the maximum allowable outer iterations used with the Adaptive Time Step (ATS) capability if it is active.

name: ats_percel
description: fractional cell distance submitted by the ADV Package to the adaptive time stepping (ATS) package.

name: auto_flow_reduce
description: keyword and real value that defines the fraction of the cell thickness used as an interval for smoothly adjusting negative pumping rates to 0 in cells with head values less than or equal to the bottom

name: auxdepthname
description: name of a variable listed in AUXILIARY that defines the depth at which drainage discharge will be scaled.
notes: Unlike AUXMULTNAME, gives an aux column a new physical role (drain scaling depth).
derivation_basis: depth-scaled conductance from aux in drn_cf/drn_fc each iteration

name: complexity
description: is an optional keyword that defines default non-linear and linear solver parameters.
notes: IMS/PTS: a preset that expands to solver parameter defaults. Expanding it is lossless. The parameters themselves are logical.
derivation_basis: preset expanded to solver defaults once

name: csv_inner_output_filerecord
description: name of the ascii comma separated values output file to write solver convergence information.

name: csv_outer_output_filerecord
description: name of the ascii comma separated values output file to write maximum dependent-variable (for example, head) change convergence information at the end of each outer iteration for each time step.

name: csv_output_filerecord
description: name of the ascii comma separated values output file to write solver convergence information.

name: cvoptions
description: none

name: dependent_variable_scaling
description: flag to scale X and RHS to avoid very large positive or negative dependent variable values
notes: Numerics; effect on results is round-off only. Borderline with run directive.

name: dev_cubic_scaling
description: cubic-scaling is used to scale the drain conductance

name: first_order_decay
description: is a text keyword to indicate that first-order decay will occur.
notes: Process switch that also decides which griddata arrays exist.

name: fixed_conductance
description: keyword to indicate that the product of the bedleak and cfact input variables in the exchangedata block represents conductance.
notes: Switches off depth smoothing and wetted-perimeter area: different physics, not a re-encoding.

name: flow_imbalance_correction
description: correct for an imbalance in flows by assuming that any residual flow error comes in or leaves at the temperature of the cell.

name: flow_reduction_length
description: keyword that indicates the AUTO_FLOW_REDUCE value is a length instead of a fraction of the cell thickness.
notes: AUTO_FLOW_REDUCE given as length instead of fraction of (static) cell thickness. Per-cell lens: one length ≠ one fraction across cells, so a uniform scalar may not re-encode to a scalar. Partial lens.
derivation_basis: length vs fraction of fixed cell thickness

name: gwfmodelname1
description: keyword to specify name of first corresponding GWF Model.

name: gwfmodelname2
description: keyword to specify name of second corresponding GWF Model.

name: head_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write head information.

name: maximum_iterations
description: integer value that defines the maximum number of Newton-Raphson iterations allowed for a lake.

name: no_ptcrecord
description: is an optional keyword that is used to define options for disabling pseudo-transient continuation (PTC).

name: print_option
description: is a flag that controls printing of convergence information from the solver.

name: print_stage
description: keyword to indicate that the list of lake {#2} will be printed to the listing file for every stress period in which 'HEAD PRINT' is specified in Output Control.

name: scheme
description: scheme used to solve the advection term.

name: sorbate_filerecord
description: name of the output file to write immobile sorbate concentration information.

name: sorption
description: is a text keyword to indicate that sorption will be activated.
notes: Process switch that also decides which griddata arrays exist.

name: track_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write tracking information.

name: trackcsv_filerecord
description: name of the comma-separated value (CSV) file to write tracking information.

name: xt3d_off
description: deactivate the xt3d method and use the faster and less accurate approximation.

name: xt3d_rhs
description: add xt3d terms to right-hand side, when possible.

name: zero_order_decay
description: is a text keyword to indicate that zero-order decay will occur.
notes: Process switch that also decides which griddata arrays exist.

name: alternative_cell_averaging
description: is a text keyword to indicate that an alternative method will be used for calculating the conductance for horizontal cell connections.

name: ats_filerecord
description: defines an adaptive time step (ATS) input file defining ATS controls.

name: beta
description: compressibility of water.

name: cell_averaging
description: is a keyword and text keyword to indicate the method that will be used for calculating the conductance for horizontal cell connections.

name: cell_fraction
description: keyword to indicate that the thickness of interbeds will be specified in terms of the fraction of cell thickness.
notes: Interbed THICK given as fraction of cell thickness (static).
derivation_basis: fraction of fixed cell thickness

name: chunk_face
description: is the keyword used to provide a data chunk size for the face dimension in a NETCDF_MESH2D output file.

name: chunk_time
description: is the keyword used to provide a data chunk size for the time dimension in a NETCDF_MESH2D or NETCDF_STRUCTURED output file.

name: chunk_x
description: is the keyword used to provide a data chunk size for the x dimension in a NETCDF_STRUCTURED output file.

name: chunk_y
description: is the keyword used to provide a data chunk size for the y dimension in a NETCDF_STRUCTURED output file.

name: chunk_z
description: is the keyword used to provide a data chunk size for the z dimension in a NETCDF_STRUCTURED output file.

name: cim_filerecord
description: name of the output file to write immobile concentrations.

name: cnd_xt3d_off
description: deactivate the xt3d method for the dispersive flux and use the faster and less accurate approximation for this exchange.

name: cnd_xt3d_rhs
description: add xt3d dispersion terms to right-hand side, when possible, for this exchange.

name: compaction_coarse_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write elastic coarse-grained material compaction information.

name: compaction_elastic_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write elastic interbed compaction information.

name: compaction_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write compaction information.

name: compaction_inelastic_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write inelastic interbed compaction information.

name: compaction_interbed_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write interbed compaction information.

name: compression_indices
description: keyword to indicate that the recompression (CR) and compression (CC) indices are specified instead of the elastic specific storage (SSE) and inelastic specific storage (SSV) coefficients.
notes: CR/CC vs SSE/SSI. MF6 converts SS to CR at init using void ratio and initial effective stress: computed lens. Check behaviour under HEAD_BASED before relying.
derivation_basis: SS to CR/CC via initial void ratio and stress

name: continue
description: keyword flag to indicate that the simulation should continue even if one or more solutions do not converge.
notes: Run directive: policy on non-convergence. Closest to logical of the run directives.

name: coordinate_check_method
description: approach for verifying that release point coordinates are in the cell with the specified ID.
notes: Run directive: input validation. Changes whether the run errors, not what it computes.

name: deflate
description: is the variable deflate level (0=min, 9=max) in the NetCDF file.

name: denseref
description: fluid reference density used in the equation of state.

name: density_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write density information.

name: density_water
description: density of water used by calculations related to heat storage and conduction.

name: dev_cycle_detection_window
description: integer value defining the size of the window (number of consecutive exit events) used for cycle detection.

name: dev_dump_event_trace
description: print a verbose particle tracking event trace to standard output
notes: Run directive: logging/profiling, not a file of results.

name: dev_efh_formulation
description: use the variable-density equivalent freshwater head formulation instead of the hydraulic head head formulation.

name: dev_exit_solve_method
description: the method for iterative solution of particle exit location and time in the generalized Pollock's method.

name: dev_forceternary
description: force use of the ternary tracking method regardless of cell type in DISV grids.

name: dev_log_mpi
description: keyword to enable (extremely verbose) logging of mpi traffic to file.
notes: Run directive: logging/profiling, not a file of results.

name: dev_oldstorageformulation
description: development option flag for old storage formulation

name: dev_omega
description: set saturation omega value

name: dev_original_specific_storage
description: flag indicating the original storage specific storage formulation should be used

name: dev_storage_weight
description: real number value that defines the time weighting factor used to calculate the change in channel storage.

name: digits
description: Keyword and an integer digits specifier used for conversion of simulated values to text on output.

name: disable_storage_change_integration
description: keyword that deactivates inclusion of storage derivative terms in the STO package matrix formulation.

name: drape
description: is a text keyword to indicate that if a particle's release point is in a cell that happens to be inactive at release time, the particle is to be moved to the topmost active cell below it, if any.

name: dry_tracking_method
description: is a string indicating how particles should behave in dry-but-active cells (as can occur with the Newton formulation).

name: dsp_xt3d_off
description: deactivate the xt3d method for the dispersive flux and use the faster and less accurate approximation for this exchange.

name: dsp_xt3d_rhs
description: add xt3d dispersion terms to right-hand side, when possible, for this exchange.

name: effective_stress_lag
description: keyword to indicate the effective stress from the previous time step will be used to calculate specific storage values.

name: exit_solve_tolerance
description: the convergence tolerance for iterative solution of particle exit location and time in the generalized Pollock's method.

name: explicit
description: keyword to indicate that the ghost node correction is applied in an explicit manner on the right-hand side of the matrix.

name: extend_tracking
description: indicates that particles should be tracked beyond the end of the simulation's final time step (using that time step's flows) until particles terminate or reach a specified stop time.

name: flow_correction
description: keyword that activates flow corrections in cases where the head in a multi-aquifer well is below the bottom of the screen for a connection or the head in a convertible cell connected to a multi-aquife

name: flowing_wells
description: keyword that activates the flowing wells option for the multi-aquifer well package.

name: gammaw
description: unit weight of water.

name: gnc_filerecord
description: is the file name for ghost node correction input file.

name: head_based
description: keyword to indicate the head-based formulation will be used to simulate coarse-grained aquifer materials and no-delay and delay interbeds.
notes: Formulation switch (lhead_based: logical) that also sets IPCH, i.e. preconsolidation given as head (the encoding INITIAL_PRECONSOLIDATION_HEAD selects). Two concepts on one keyword; the encoding part cannot be chosen separately.
derivation_basis: forces IPCH (preconsolidation as head): the static part of a formulation switch

name: heat_capacity_water
description: heat capacity of water used by calculations related to heat storage and conduction.

name: hhformulation_rhs
description: use the variable-density hydraulic head formulation and add off-diagonal terms to the right-hand.

name: highest_cell_saturation
description: keyword indicating that the maximum cell bottom will be used to calculate the saturation used to calculate the horizontal conductance between cells.

name: highest_saturated
description: Apply mass source loading rate to specified CELLID or highest underlying cell with a cell saturation greater than zero.

name: hpc_filerecord
description: hpc record
notes: Run directive: parallel partitioning. Results invariant up to round-off.

name: initial_preconsolidation_head
description: keyword to indicate that preconsolidation heads will be specified for no-delay and delay interbeds in the PACKAGEDATA block.
notes: PCS given as head, not stress. Computed lens (geostatic stress).
derivation_basis: head to stress via initial geostatic stress

name: istopzone
description: integer value defining the stop zone number.

name: k22overk
description: keyword to indicate that specified K22 is a ratio of K22 divided by K.
notes: K22/K33 given as ratio to K. Applied at load (npf:1957,1987) and to TVK values against the then-current K11 (tvk:239-250). Lens spans NPF+TVK; needs TVK schedule.
derivation_basis: decoded at load (npf:1987) and on each TVK write against K11 at that time (tvk:239); later K11 changes do not propagate

name: k33overk
description: keyword to indicate that specified K33 is a ratio of K33 divided by K.
notes: K22/K33 given as ratio to K. Applied at load (npf:1957,1987) and to TVK values against the then-current K11 (tvk:239-250). Lens spans NPF+TVK; needs TVK schedule.
derivation_basis: as k22overk (npf:1957, tvk:250)

name: latent_heat_vaporization
description: latent heat of vaporization is the amount of energy that is required to convert a given quantity of liquid into a gas and is associated with evaporative cooling.

name: linear_gwet
description: keyword specifying that groundwater ET will be simulated using the original ET formulation of MODFLOW-2005.

name: local_z
description: indicates that 'zrpt' defines the local z coordinate of the release point within the cell, with value of 0 at the bottom and 1 at the effective top of the cell.
notes: Looks like a coordinate encoding, but scales by simulated saturation at release time (gwfsat), so it is a statement about the model, not a static lens.
derivation_basis: scaled by simulated saturation at release (prt-prp:706)

name: maxerrors
description: maximum number of errors that will be stored and printed.
notes: Run directive: input validation. Changes whether the run errors, not what it computes.

name: maximum_depth_change
description: real value that defines the depth closure tolerance.

name: maximum_picard_iterations
description: integer value that defines the maximum number of Streamflow Routing picard iterations allowed when solving for reach stages and flows as part of the GWF formulate step.

name: maximum_stage_change
description: real value that defines the lake stage closure tolerance.

name: memory_print_option
description: is a flag that controls printing of detailed memory manager usage to the end of the simulation list file.
notes: Run directive: logging/profiling, not a file of results.

name: mfrcsv_filerecord
description: name of the comma-separated value (CSV) output file to write information about multi-aquifer well extraction or injection rates that have been reduced by the program.

name: modelnames
description: keyword to indicate that all package names will be preceded by the model name for the package.
notes: MVR: package references written model-qualified. Reference encoding only.

name: modflow6_attr_off
description: is the keyword used to turn off internal input tagging in the model NetCDF file.

name: mve_filerecord
description: is the file name of the transport mover input file to apply to this exchange.

name: mvr_filerecord
description: is the file name of the water mover input file to apply to this exchange.

name: mvt_filerecord
description: is the file name of the transport mover input file to apply to this exchange.

name: ndelaycells
description: number of nodes used to discretize delay interbeds.

name: newton
description: keyword that activates the Newton-Raphson formulation for groundwater flow between connected, convertible groundwater cells.

name: no_well_storage
description: keyword that deactivates inclusion of well storage contributions to the multi-aquifer well package continuity equation.

name: nocheck
description: keyword flag to indicate that the model input check routines should not be called prior to each time step.
notes: Run directive: input validation. Changes whether the run errors, not what it computes.

name: perched
description: keyword to indicate that when a cell is overlying a dewatered convertible cell, the head difference used in Darcy's Law is equal to the head in the overlying cell minus the bottom elevation of the ove

name: print_head
description: keyword to indicate that the list of multi-aquifer well {#2} will be printed to the listing file for every stress period in which 'HEAD PRINT' is specified in Output Control.

name: print_table
description: keyword to indicate that the partition table will be printed to the listing file.
notes: Run directive: logging/profiling, not a file of results.

name: profile_option
description: is a flag that controls performance profiling and reporting.
notes: Run directive: logging/profiling, not a file of results.

name: release_time_frequency
description: real number indicating the time frequency at which to release particles.

name: release_time_tolerance
description: real number indicating the tolerance within which to consider consecutive release times coincident.

name: release_timesfilerecord
description: name of the release times file.
notes: External file for the release-times values.

name: release_timesrecord
description: times to release, relative to the beginning of the simulation.
notes: Values. Has an alternative encoding (RELEASETIMES block / file) to check in step 2.

name: rewet_record
description: is a keyword and factor that is included in the calculation of the head that is initially established at a cell when that cell is converted from dry to wet.

name: save_saturation
description: keyword to indicate that cell saturation will be written to the budget file, which is specified with 'BUDGET SAVE FILE' in Output Control.

name: save_specific_discharge
description: keyword to indicate that x, y, and z components of specific discharge will be calculated at cell centers and written to the budget file, which is specified with 'BUDGET SAVE FILE' in Output Control.
notes: Also forces spdis to be computed; computing it does not change the solution.

name: shuffle
description: is the keyword used to turn on the NetCDF variable shuffle filter when the deflate option is also set.

name: shutdown_kappa
description: value that defines the weight applied to discharge rate for wells that limit the water level in a discharging well (defined using the HEAD_LIMIT keyword in the stress period data).

name: shutdown_theta
description: value that defines the weight applied to discharge rate for wells that limit the water level in a discharging well (defined using the HEAD_LIMIT keyword in the stress period data).

name: simulate_et
description: keyword specifying that ET in the unsaturated (UZF) and saturated zones (GWF) will be simulated.

name: simulate_gwseep
description: keyword specifying that groundwater discharge (GWSEEP) to land surface will be simulated.

name: specified_initial_delay_head
description: keyword to indicate that absolute initial delay bed head will be specified for interbeds defined in the PACKAGEDATA block.
notes: Absolute vs offset-from-initial-state. Computed lens: needs initial effective stress (from STRT, TOP/BOT, geostatic) to re-encode.
derivation_basis: offset from initial state, computed once

name: specified_initial_interbed_state
description: keyword to indicate that absolute preconsolidation stresses (heads) and delay bed heads will be specified for interbeds defined in the PACKAGEDATA block.
notes: Absolute vs offset-from-initial-state. Computed lens: needs initial effective stress (from STRT, TOP/BOT, geostatic) to re-encode.
derivation_basis: offset from initial state, computed once

name: specified_initial_preconsolidation_stress
description: keyword to indicate that absolute preconsolidation stresses (heads) will be specified for interbeds defined in the PACKAGEDATA block.
notes: Absolute vs offset-from-initial-state. Computed lens: needs initial effective stress (from STRT, TOP/BOT, geostatic) to re-encode.
derivation_basis: offset from initial state, computed once

name: square_gwet
description: keyword specifying that groundwater ET will be simulated by assuming a constant ET rate for groundwater levels between land surface (TOP) and land surface minus the ET extinction depth (TOP-EXTDP).

name: ss_confined_only
description: keyword to indicate that compressible storage is only calculated for a convertible cell (ICONVERT>0) when the cell is under confined conditions (head greater than or equal to the top of the cell).

name: start_date_time
description: is the starting date and time of the simulation.
notes: Descriptive metadata: no runtime effect, kept by any conversion.

name: stop_at_weak_sink
description: is a text keyword to indicate that a particle is to terminate when it enters a cell that is a weak sink.

name: stoptime
description: real value defining the maximum simulation time to which particles in the package can be tracked.

name: stoptraveltime
description: real value defining the maximum travel time over which particles in the model can be tracked.

name: storage
description: keyword that activates storage contributions to the stream-flow routing package continuity equation.

name: storagecoefficient
description: keyword to indicate that the SS array is read as storage coefficient rather than specific storage.
notes: SS given as S; thickness=1 instead of top-bot (static). Lens spans STO+TVS. Runtime memory holds the undecoded value: decoding is lazy.
derivation_basis: decoded at use (SsCapacity) but against top-bot, which is fixed

name: straincg_filerecord
description: name of the comma-separated-values output file to write final coarse-grained material strain information.

name: strainib_filerecord
description: name of the comma-separated-values output file to write final interbed strain information.

name: surf_rate_specified
description: indicates that the proportion of the evapotranspiration rate at the ET surface will be specified as PETM0 in list input.

name: surfdep
description: real value that defines the surface depression depth for VERTICAL lake-GWF connections.

name: temperature_species_name
description: string used to identify the auxspeciesname in PACKAGEDATA that corresponds to the temperature species.
notes: Key reference to a PACKAGEDATA row (intra-component reference).

name: thermal_a2
description: is an empirical parameter specified by the user for calculating viscosity using a nonlinear formulation.

name: thermal_a3
description: is an empirical parameter specified by the user for calculating viscosity using a nonlinear formulation.

name: thermal_a4
description: is an empirical parameter specified by the user for calculating viscosity using a nonlinear formulation.

name: thermal_formulation
description: may be used for specifying which viscosity formulation to use for the temperature species.

name: thickstrt
description: indicates that cells having a negative ICELLTYPE are confined, and their cell thickness for conductance calculations will be computed as STRT-BOT rather than TOP-BOT.
notes: Thickness from STRT-BOT: not re-encodable by editing TOP, which has other uses.
derivation_basis: thickness from STRT - BOT, computed once; no input column holds the result, so it stays logical

name: time_units
description: is the time units of the simulation.
notes: Descriptive metadata: no runtime effect, kept by any conversion.

name: track_dropped
description: keyword to indicate that particle tracking output is to be written when a particle is dropped to the water table via DRY_TRACKING_METHOD DROP.

name: track_exit
description: keyword to indicate that particle tracking output is to be written when a particle exits a grid feature (e.g.

name: track_release
description: keyword to indicate that particle tracking output is to be written when a particle is released

name: track_subfeature_exit
description: keyword to indicate that particle tracking output is to be written when a particle exits a sub-grid-scale feature.

name: track_terminate
description: keyword to indicate that particle tracking output is to be written when a particle terminates for any reason

name: track_timesfilerecord
description: name of the tracking times file
notes: External file for the tracking-times values. The option is layout; the values are output directives.

name: track_timesrecord
description: times to track, relative to the beginning of the simulation.

name: track_timestep
description: keyword to indicate that particle tracking output is to be written at the end of each time step

name: track_usertime
description: keyword to indicate that particle tracking output is to be written at user-specified times, provided as double precision values in the TRACKTIMES block.

name: track_weaksink
description: keyword to indicate that particle tracking output is to be written when a particle exits a weak sink (a cell which removes some but not all inflow from adjacent cells)

name: tvk_filerecord
description: defines a time-varying hydraulic conductivity (TVK) input file.

name: tvs_filerecord
description: defines a time-varying storage (TVS) input file.

name: unit_conversion
description: real value that is used to convert user-specified Manning's roughness coefficients from seconds per meters$^{1/3}$ to model length and time units.
notes: SFR: same constant Manning factor as DFW length/time_conversion.
derivation_basis: constant factor

name: unsat_etae
description: keyword specifying that ET in the unsaturated zone will be simulated using a capillary pressure based formulation.

name: unsat_etwc
description: keyword specifying that ET in the unsaturated zone will be simulated as a function of the specified PET rate while the water content (THETA) is greater than the ET extinction water content (EXTWC).

name: update_material_properties
description: keyword to indicate that the thickness and void ratio of coarse-grained and interbed sediments (delay and no-delay) will vary during the simulation.

name: viscosity_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write viscosity information.

name: viscref
description: fluid reference viscosity used in the equation of state.

name: wc_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write water content information.

name: wkt
description: is the coordinate reference system (CRS) well-known text (WKT) string.
notes: Descriptive metadata: no runtime effect, kept by any conversion.

name: xt3d
description: keyword that activates the XT3D formulation between the cells connected with this GWF-GWF Exchange.

name: xt3doptions
description: none

name: zdisplacement_filerecord
description: name of the binary output file to write z-displacement information.

name: zero_order_decay_solid
description: is a text keyword to indicate that zero-order decay will occur in the solid phase.
notes: Process switch that also decides which griddata arrays exist.

name: zero_order_decay_water
description: is a text keyword to indicate that zero-order decay will occur in the aqueous phase.
notes: Process switch that also decides which griddata arrays exist.
